entries.text: Watch your step. It’s pretty dark...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_01

entries.text: This is one of the Herba Mystica! It’s exactly how\nit looked in the book![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You and Arven found the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)][VAR 0x0109(0001)][VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_01

entries.text: YES! We actually found one! And it’s all thanks to\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_04

entries.text: Now then, let’s see... What does the book have\nto say?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_05

entries.text:
It says here that the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sweet Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is good
for gut health and that it helps aid digestion.\c
Says it’s great for stomachaches, too, or when
you want to stimulate the ol’ appetite![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_a

entries.text:
Well, apparently [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Salty Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] helps with
aching hands and feet. Good for neuropathy and
numbness.\c
When you’ve got muscle weakness, it supposedly
builds up strength again![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_b

entries.text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Bitter Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s great for your circulation!
It really gets the blood flowing!\c
And that warms you right up, nice and toasty,
even boosting the immune system!\c
...Or so it says.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_c

entries.text:
OK, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sour Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is chock-full of nutrients
and is great for boosting your overall health!\c
Says here it works wonders whether you’re tired
physically or mentally. Perks you right up![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_d

entries.text:
So it seems [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Spicy Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s supposed to
boost your metabolism!\c
It gives your circulation a boost and helps flush
out all those toxins...along with a ton of sweat![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_e

entries.text: Now if I can just get him to eat some...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_06

entries.text: All right! Now it’s my turn to show off what I can\ndo. You’re about to get a taste of my cooking![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_07

entries.text: Yeeeaaarrrghhh! Hiya! Hwatcha! Hyah![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_14

entries.text: Here you go!\c\nAn Arven-original sandwich packed full of herbs![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_08

entries.text:
And I’ll even give you a badge—y’know, as a
thank-you for taking on that Titan Pokémon.\c
I call it a Titan Badge. Made it myself, using a
replica of the Gym Badges, see?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_09

entries.text: Agia!
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_00

entries.text: Argh! What’s up with that thing?! It just comes\nout of its ball on its own whenever it wants?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_10

entries.text: *sniff sniff*
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_01

entries.text: ...Hey now. No. That’s not for you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_11

entries.text: Grrrrrr...
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do you want to give your sandwich\nto [VAR 0x0101(0001)]?
entries.label: legend_0020_system_02

entries.text: Here you go!
entries.label: legend_0020_select_01

entries.text: This is mine...
entries.label: legend_0020_select_02

entries.text: Giaaawn...
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Maybe you want to give your sandwich to\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\r\nafter all?
entries.label: legend_0020_system_03

entries.text: *chomp chomp* *snarf* *chomp*
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_04

entries.text: Hey! I went through all the trouble of making\nthat for you, and you just give it away?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_12

entries.text: I hope you realize that’s all there was, so now\nthere’s none left for you...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_13

entries.text: That’s totally fine!
entries.label: legend_0020_select_03

entries.text: Wait, really...?
entries.label: legend_0020_select_04

entries.text: Aw, come on! Now you’re making me feel like\nI’m the selfish jerk here![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_14a

entries.text: All right, all right! Don’t look at me like that![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_14b

entries.text: Here, you can have half of mine. But you’d better\nsavor every last bite![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_15

entries.text: Gia! Giaaaw!
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_05

entries.text: Huh? You already ate that whole thing?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_16

entries.text: Agiaaas!
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to dash now!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to jump\nhigher now!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to glide now!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_06

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to move across the\nwater now!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to climb up
vertical
surfaces
now!
entries.label: legend_0020_system_08

entries.text: Wha—?! Hey, is it me or has this thing sort of...\npowered up somehow?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_17

entries.text: Agia!
entries.label: legend_0020_legend_07

entries.text: Whoa! I can’t believe it! The power of these\nherbs really is worth guarding![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_18

entries.text: If they had that big an effect on your Pokémon,\nthen I bet—[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_19

entries.text: Uhhh... I bet it’ll come in super handy for that\nTreasure Hunt assignment we’ve got!\c\nYup! That’s what I bet![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_20

entries.text: Well, you’ve both filled your bellies with some\nof my legendary sandwiches![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_21

entries.text: Guess it’s time to tidy everything up...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_22

entries.text: Oh, don’t you worry about helping! After battling\nthe Titan, you’ve earned a break![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_23

entries.text: Just leave all this to me! Though I’d be much\nobliged if you’d get a start on searching out the\r\nremaining four Herba Mystica for us.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_24

entries.text: I really owe you...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_25

entries.text: OK. The coast is clear.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0020_friend_28

entries.text: You can come out now.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
